title: Darouna Jungle, Hai Raat Andheri,
body:
Darouna jungle, hai raat andheri,
Sitaare kuch jhilmila rahe hain
Pardey hain rethi pah chand laashe
Joh apna gham aap kha rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hae aisa bigda huva zamana na
Gore hae aur na shamiyana
Falak pah abre siyaah ke lakke
Udaasi bun bun ke cha rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Na koyi zaqmoun ka dhone wala
Na koi murdoun pah ronay wala
Parind kuch kar rahe hain naalay
Darindh kuch qaak uda rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shikista hathyar kuch padey hain
Yeh loug shayad yahan lade hain
Laday toh woh honge joh badey hain
Nazar toh bachhe bhi aarahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh run joh is waqt bolta hae
Unhee shaheedon ki yeh sada hae
Musafir aatey hain joh idhar se
Woh raah katrah ke ja rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Haram pah kya guzri baad inke
Nahin zaroorat ke koi bole
Jale huve joh pade hain qaime
Khud unka lutna batah rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shifa-ate hashr karne wale
Kahen woh joh kar guzar ne wale
Ghayoor hain yeh woh marne wale
Joh hum ko ab tak rula rahe hain
